semantic_contract: Trap with brk #0x5512 when error_no is outside the 0..18 valid range.
If the error was previously counted less than 60000 milliseconds ago, log the repeat, increment the count and return -EIO.
At or beyond the 60000 millisecond boundary, increment the count and return zero.
Use the proven ztp_device zlog_item count and timer offsets without adding a runtime bounds policy that stock does not have.
